description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/livingroom_4/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/livingroom_4/questions.pdf; its answer (6) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation; hard = two chained relations.
The iref data labels both single-seat armchairs as 'sofa', which is why the sample question's answer of 6 includes the pillow on each armchair. Q02 makes that convention explicit.
Q05 counts 'window frame' rather than 'window': the iref data splits every window into an upper and a lower sash, so counting 'window' would give 8 for the 4 openings a human sees.
Curtains are not used as a count target: the four labelled curtain objects each cover a window with what renders as a pair of panels, so a human would plausibly answer 8.
Only large, unambiguous objects are counted. Candles, figurines, drawers and structural classes (wall/floor/ceiling) are excluded because they are too small or too abstract to ground reliably.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many pillows are on a sofa?
questions.evidence: Four pillows (87, 91, 100, 116) on the long sofa 49 plus one on each armchair (60 on 51, 73 on 88).

questions.question: How many sofas are in the room?
questions.evidence: One long three-seat sofa (49) and two matching single-seat sofas (51, 88) around the coffee table.

questions.question: How many columns are in the room?
questions.evidence: Four square columns mark the corners of the open-plan room (13, 66, 68, 95).

questions.question: How many lamps are hanging from the ceiling?
questions.evidence: A chandelier over the seating area (6) and two wire pendants over the dining table (3, 57).

questions.question: How many windows are in the room?
questions.evidence: Four windows (frames 37, 78, 103, 111), each dressed with red curtains.

questions.question: How many chairs are around the dining table?
questions.evidence: Six chairs (48, 81, 97, 104, 106, 118) surround the glass dining table 62 within 1.2 m.

questions.question: How many candlesticks are on the fireplace mantel?
questions.evidence: Two candlesticks (72, 83) stand on the mantel of fireplace 112, flanking the horse figurine.

questions.question: How many potted plants are standing on the floor?
questions.evidence: Three floor planters (5, 11, 38); the other two potted plants sit on the dining table and inside the bookcase.

questions.question: How many pictures are hanging on the wall next to the dining table?
questions.evidence: Three butterfly prints (17, 20, 28) hang on the wall beside dining table 62; the other four pictures are on the far side of the room.

questions.question: How many books are on the table with the vase of flowers on it?
questions.evidence: Vase 89 with flowers stands on coffee table 67, which also holds books 34 and 44; every other book in the scene is in the bookcase.
